metadata.description: Mods for Claude Code by Tarl Raney

plugins.name: usage-bar
plugins.description: Band above the prompt showing Session, Weekly and Fable 5.1 usage

plugins.name: staff-board
plugins.description: Every Claude Code session on your PC as a little Clawd above the prompt: coloured by model, glowing by effort, with what it is doing and its agents

plugins.name: compact-brief
plugins.description: Tells compaction what to keep: your own words near verbatim first, then what changed, then findings, with tool output described in a few words

plugins.name: compact-tail
plugins.description: Automatic compaction summarizes only the older part and keeps the latest part word for word; a reopen tool brings back anything summarized
